# Hangbug — Full Platform Documentation for Language Models

## Platform Overview
Hangbug (https://www.hangbug.com) is an online technology learning and technical skill assessment platform. It serves developers, university students, and technology learners who want to practice multiple-choice (MCQ) programming quizzes, improve typing and code debugging speed, monitor ongoing accuracy, and earn verifiable, score-based completion certificates.

Hangbug is accessible on both Web (https://www.hangbug.com) and Android mobile devices (via the official Hangbug mobile app, package `com.hangbug.app`).

## System Architecture
- **Web Frontend:** React 19 single-page application built with Vite and Tailwind CSS, hosted on Vercel Edge.
- **Mobile Application:** Flutter/Dart Android native app with Material 3 design, full session persistence, and Google Authentication.
- **Backend API:** Node.js Express service running on Vercel Serverless Functions with Prisma ORM connecting to MongoDB Atlas.
- **SEO & Search Standards:** Canonical trailing slash normalization, dynamic sitemap XML generation, structured Schema.org JSON-LD (Organization, WebSite, WebPage, SoftwareApplication, BreadcrumbList), Open Graph and Twitter Card tags.

## Core Features
1. **Interactive MCQ Quizzes:** Questions organized into sequential 10-15 question practice sessions with immediate feedback, explanations, and progress saving.
2. **Score-Based Developer Certificates:** Automatically generated upon scoring passing thresholds (Pass: 60-74%, Merit: 75-89%, Distinction: 90%+), verifiable publicly at `/certificate/view?id=<UUID>`.
3. **Coding & Typing Games:** 20 interactive mini-games including Code Puzzle, Find The Bug, Output Predictor, SQL Challenge, Speed Typing, and Code Typing.
4. **Global Leaderboard:** Real-time scoring and rank tracking across quizzes and games.
5. **Session Progress Persistence:** Authenticated users resume in-progress quiz sessions without losing answered questions.

## Technology Quiz Directory
- **HTML:** Semantic tags, forms, media, accessibility, and HTML5 APIs. URL: https://www.hangbug.com/technologies/html
- **CSS:** Selectors, specificity, Flexbox, CSS Grid, transforms, transitions, and media queries. URL: https://www.hangbug.com/technologies/css
- **JavaScript:** ES6+, scoping, closures, promises, async/await, DOM manipulation, event loop. URL: https://www.hangbug.com/technologies/javascript
- **React:** Components, props, state, useEffect, custom hooks, context, memoization. URL: https://www.hangbug.com/technologies/react
- **PHP:** Syntax, arrays, functions, OOP, exceptions, sessions, PDO. URL: https://www.hangbug.com/technologies/php
- **Laravel:** MVC, routing, Eloquent ORM, Blade, middleware, service providers, migrations. URL: https://www.hangbug.com/technologies/laravel
- **MySQL:** SELECT, JOINs, GROUP BY, aggregations, foreign keys, indexes, transactions. URL: https://www.hangbug.com/technologies/mysql
- **MongoDB:** Collections, BSON documents, CRUD queries, indexes, aggregation pipeline. URL: https://www.hangbug.com/technologies/mongodb
- **Flutter:** Widgets (Stateless & Stateful), BuildContext, layout constraints, Navigator, state management. URL: https://www.hangbug.com/technologies/flutter
- **Dart:** Type system, null safety, collections, async streams, mixins, isolates. URL: https://www.hangbug.com/technologies/dart
- **Python:** Data types, list comprehensions, OOP, decorators, generators, file I/O. URL: https://www.hangbug.com/technologies/python
- **Programming Fundamentals:** Binary arithmetic, Big-O complexity, algorithms, data structures (linked lists, trees, stacks, queues). URL: https://www.hangbug.com/technologies/programming-fundamentals
